items.title: Henry "Jack" Palmer Interview
items.q: The interviewee (Henry 'Jack' Palmer) does not mention Roland Tumlin. The interviewer mentions 'Roland Tumlin' as a pseudonym/alias used by the interviewer ('I was Delta Joe and Roland Tumlin') and discusses the recording history. ctx.x: I know Peter Weistraugh. But I know this one saying that ain't nothing.

Because Sax was Willie Kelly and Hunter Dripper. And I was Delta Joe and Roland Tumlin. I know. I made Roland Tumlin after I made a family. You know, old old man. You met Roland and Tumlin? I was Delta Joe and once. Delta? Delta Joe. He called me Delta Joe. My brother remember that. I know. I made Roland and Tomlin after I made a family.
